intro.text: A chasm on the Shattered Plains, a short walk from Sadeas's warcamp.

description.text: The chasm starts narrow and grows wider and deeper as it runs east. Its edge lies down a slope, and six ladders let bridgemen climb down into it.
It is the only place Sadeas's bridge crews may go unsupervised, and bridgemen go there to end their lives. Gaz prefers that they leave their sandals and vests behind first.

title.text: The war on the Shattered Plains

items.text: The night before Kaladin was assigned to Bridge Four, the crew's bridgeleader threw himself into the chasm.
Kaladin went to the chasm meaning to jump, but the return of his spren companion stopped him, and he went back to camp determined to try once more.
